subject: Science
description: Identify single and double replacement reactions by tracking which elements or ion groups switch places, using the patterns A + BC -> AC + B and AB + CD -> AD + CB.
learningObjectives: Describe single replacement reactions using the pattern A + BC -> AC + B
Describe double replacement reactions using the pattern AB + CD -> AD + CB
Identify which atom, ion, or group switches partners in a chemical equation
Use reaction clues such as precipitate, gas, or water formation to recognize double replacement reactions
prerequisites: Recognize reactants and products in a chemical equation
Understand element symbols and simple chemical formulas
Identify synthesis and decomposition reaction patterns
